decision_question: Which repeated member outcome must the platform make easier?
evidence_to_request: Interview synthesis, proposed member journey, and one measurable success event
minimum_pass_condition: One primary job is supported end to end without custom work
red_flag: The decision is driven by a feature list or visual preference

decision_question: Can a new member reach first value in one session?
evidence_to_request: Live walkthrough using a blank test account and a timed activation script
minimum_pass_condition: The critical path is understandable, instrumentable, and under ten minutes
red_flag: Activation requires staff intervention or undocumented workarounds

decision_question: Can the product express the weekly behavior that creates retention?
evidence_to_request: A configured prototype using the real content, roles, and member journey
minimum_pass_condition: The loop can run for a 90-day cohort without a bespoke application
red_flag: The vendor proposes roadmap promises for the central behavior

decision_question: Can spaces, courses, groups, roles, and permissions match the intended operating model?
evidence_to_request: Configured sandbox and a written map of limits, nesting, and role inheritance
minimum_pass_condition: The intended model fits without duplicating people or content
red_flag: Critical structure depends on naming hacks or manual duplication

decision_question: Which interface elements can be changed without vendor services?
evidence_to_request: Theme documentation, CSS limits, component inventory, and a branded sandbox
minimum_pass_condition: Typography, color, domain, navigation, and key landing surfaces meet the launch bar
red_flag: White label means only removing a vendor logo

decision_question: Can one critical journey be replaced or embedded?
evidence_to_request: Headless, SDK, extension, embed, or custom-page documentation with a working sample
minimum_pass_condition: The differentiating journey has a supported implementation path and stable identity handoff
red_flag: Custom work depends on DOM injection or an undocumented private endpoint

decision_question: Who is the canonical identity provider and how are duplicate accounts resolved?
evidence_to_request: SSO docs, identity schema, merge flow, account deletion flow, and sandbox test
minimum_pass_condition: Stable external IDs, documented merge behavior, and reversible SSO setup
red_flag: Email address is the only durable key or merges require vendor support

decision_question: How do payment status, cohort, role, and content access combine?
evidence_to_request: Entitlement model, webhook events, failure modes, and test cases
minimum_pass_condition: Access changes are deterministic, auditable, and recover after delayed payment events
red_flag: Staff must repair access manually or roles silently override purchases

decision_question: Can every member and profile field be exported without vendor services?
evidence_to_request: A real export from the sandbox, schema documentation, and API pagination test
minimum_pass_condition: Stable IDs, timestamps, consent fields, roles, and custom fields are present
red_flag: Only names and email addresses are exportable

decision_question: Can posts, comments, courses, files, events, and moderation history leave intact?
evidence_to_request: Sample full export including relationships, attachments, authorship, and timestamps
minimum_pass_condition: Content retains IDs, hierarchy, authorship, media links, and timestamps
red_flag: Export is a visual PDF, flat feed, or paid professional-service promise

decision_question: Can follows, groups, cohorts, referrals, reputation, and progress be reconstructed?
evidence_to_request: Relationship tables or API responses plus an import/rebuild plan
minimum_pass_condition: The community graph and learning state can be rebuilt with documented keys
red_flag: Only content and contacts are portable

decision_question: Can subscriptions move without forcing members to repurchase?
evidence_to_request: Processor ownership, customer IDs, subscription export, and migration procedure
minimum_pass_condition: The creator owns the Stripe account or has a documented token-migration path
red_flag: The vendor is merchant of record with no supported subscription transition

decision_question: Does the public API cover the objects needed for the 90-day plan?
evidence_to_request: Current API reference, scopes, pagination, rate limits, changelog, and sandbox token
minimum_pass_condition: Every required read and write is documented, scoped, and tested
red_flag: Sales promises API access but no reference or test credentials exist

decision_question: Are critical events complete, signed, ordered, retryable, and replayable?
evidence_to_request: Event catalog, signature docs, retry policy, idempotency guidance, and failure simulation
minimum_pass_condition: Critical events are signed, uniquely identified, and recoverable after downtime
red_flag: Fire-and-forget webhooks have no replay or event IDs

decision_question: Is the MCP server operational or only documentation and marketing?
evidence_to_request: Official tool list, authentication model, scopes, quotas, audit behavior, and live test
minimum_pass_condition: Tools expose the required objects with least privilege and clear approval boundaries
red_flag: A generic integration logo or code tutorial is presented as live account access

decision_question: Which AI actions can create, edit, message, moderate, or delete?
evidence_to_request: Tool-level permission matrix, approval settings, audit log, and rollback demonstration
minimum_pass_condition: Consequential writes can require human approval and are attributable and reversible
red_flag: One admin credential grants every agent unrestricted write access

decision_question: Is customer or member content used to train vendor or third-party models?
evidence_to_request: DPA, subprocessors, model-provider terms, retention settings, and opt-out controls
minimum_pass_condition: Training is off by contract, retention is bounded, and sensitive fields can be excluded
red_flag: The vendor cannot identify model providers or retention behavior

decision_question: Can AI search avoid exposing private groups or restricted courses?
evidence_to_request: Permission-aware retrieval test across at least three roles
minimum_pass_condition: Retrieval enforces source permissions before results reach the model
red_flag: The model filters results only after retrieving unrestricted content

decision_question: Can staff answer who did what, when, and through which automation?
evidence_to_request: Audit-log export showing human, API, webhook, and AI actions
minimum_pass_condition: Critical actions carry actor, timestamp, object, request, and outcome
red_flag: Automation activity is indistinguishable from an administrator

decision_question: Is mobile shared, branded, or truly customer-owned?
evidence_to_request: Live store listings, contract language, release process, and reference customer call
minimum_pass_condition: The exact operating model and dependencies are explicit
red_flag: A responsive website or PWA is described as a native white-label app

decision_question: Who owns Apple and Google developer accounts, bundle IDs, signing keys, and listings?
evidence_to_request: Screenshare of account setup plus contract schedule for every asset
minimum_pass_condition: Customer accounts and transferable identifiers are used, or exit rights are explicit
red_flag: The vendor controls the listing and offers no transfer mechanism

decision_question: How quickly are urgent fixes and OS updates shipped?
evidence_to_request: Release SLA, maintenance history, rejection process, and last twelve release dates
minimum_pass_condition: Critical fixes have a defined SLA and normal releases have a predictable cadence
red_flag: App updates require a new quote or wait for a pooled release train

decision_question: How do App Store rules affect memberships and pricing?
evidence_to_request: Approved purchase flow, entitlement architecture, and fee model by country
minimum_pass_condition: The flow is policy-compliant and unit economics remain viable
red_flag: The vendor recommends hiding or bypassing platform payment rules

decision_question: Has the actual member experience been tested to WCAG 2.2 AA?
evidence_to_request: VPAT or audit, keyboard demo, screen-reader demo, captions, and remediation SLA
minimum_pass_condition: Critical journeys pass keyboard, focus, contrast, labeling, and zoom checks
red_flag: Accessibility is answered with an unsupported compliance badge

decision_question: What independent assurance covers the platform and its subprocessors?
evidence_to_request: SOC 2 or equivalent report, penetration-test summary, vulnerability process, and security contact
minimum_pass_condition: Evidence is current, scoped to the purchased service, and material findings are remediated
red_flag: Only a generic security page or self-attestation is available

decision_question: Where are production data, backups, logs, and AI requests processed?
evidence_to_request: Architecture diagram, region list, subprocessor register, and transfer mechanism
minimum_pass_condition: Residency and cross-border transfers meet the community's legal requirements
red_flag: The vendor cannot map backups or AI subprocessors to regions

decision_question: Can one member and the whole tenant be deleted from active systems and backups?
evidence_to_request: Deletion workflow, retention schedule, backup expiry, and completed test ticket
minimum_pass_condition: Timelines and exceptions are contractual and a member request can be verified
red_flag: Deletion means only hiding an account

decision_question: What reliability does the critical member journey actually receive?
evidence_to_request: Twelve-month status history, SLA, incident samples, RTO, and RPO
minimum_pass_condition: The service target matches launch risk and recovery responsibilities are explicit
red_flag: The SLA excludes the app, API, video, payments, or major dependencies

decision_question: Has the exact plan supported comparable concurrency, media, and notification volume?
evidence_to_request: Reference customers, load-test evidence, quota sheet, and a launch-day escalation plan
minimum_pass_condition: Limits and surge procedures cover the modeled 100K-audience launch
red_flag: Scale is inferred from total registered users rather than concurrent behavior

decision_question: Can staff prevent, detect, review, appeal, and document abuse?
evidence_to_request: Role matrix, queues, reporting flow, rate limits, ban evasion controls, and audit export
minimum_pass_condition: Safety workflows cover the expected harms and preserve an appeal trail
red_flag: AI moderation is offered without human review or policy controls

decision_question: Who owns an incident across platform, payments, app stores, and integrations?
evidence_to_request: Escalation matrix, support hours, severity definitions, and reference tickets
minimum_pass_condition: Named ownership and response targets exist for launch-critical incidents
red_flag: Each vendor redirects responsibility to another provider

decision_question: What is the 24-month cost at base, growth, and surge scenarios?
evidence_to_request: Plan, overage, transaction, app, API, email, video, migration, service, and engineering costs
minimum_pass_condition: The downside scenario fits the model and every metered dimension has an alert
red_flag: Headline subscription price omits mandatory implementation or usage costs

decision_question: Can pricing, quotas, and material features change during the term?
evidence_to_request: Order form, price-protection language, deprecation policy, and renewal cap
minimum_pass_condition: Material economics and required capabilities are protected for the pilot and migration window
red_flag: The vendor may remove features or multiply price without an exit period

decision_question: Can the team leave within 30 days without losing identity, revenue, or history?
evidence_to_request: Written runbook, sample exports, API tests, app-transfer terms, and deletion certificate
minimum_pass_condition: A timed exit rehearsal succeeds before the full audience is migrated
red_flag: Exit depends on goodwill, custom consulting, or a future feature

decision_question: Have comparable customers confirmed the operating reality?
evidence_to_request: Two reference calls with similar scale, paid model, app model, and customization needs
minimum_pass_condition: References validate support, exports, releases, and limits—not only onboarding
red_flag: Only testimonials selected by marketing are available

decision_question: What evidence permits renewal, expansion, headless work, or a custom build?
evidence_to_request: Signed 30/60/90 scorecard with owners and thresholds
minimum_pass_condition: Architecture spend is released only when activation, retention, economics, and a repeated constraint clear their gates
red_flag: The next build phase is scheduled before member behavior is measured
